tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List countries in the Country Facts catalog with ISO codes, capitals, regions, populations, currencies, and headline facts.

region.description: Optional geographic region filter (Asia, Americas, Europe, Africa, Oceania).

tools.name: get_country_facts
tools.description: Fetch detailed geographic, demographic, currency, language, timezone, and curated facts for a specific country by name or ISO code (e.g., japan, brazil, norway, kenya, canada, australia).

country.description: Country name, ID, or ISO-3166 alpha-3 code (e.g., japan, JPN, brazil, BRA, norway, kenya, canada, australia).

tools.name: get_authenticated_caller
tools.description: Return the verified Google OAuth 2.0 caller identity, Apigee X proxy mediation metadata, and hosting GCP project of the Country Facts MCP server.

annotations.title: Get Country MCP & Apigee Caller Info
